jsonMapping.meaning: F-M1 consumes only runtime user-owned data (export_files / study_events rows the learner creates) and a transient library selection. There is no sample JSON file and no seedable problem/content payload for this modal, so there is no JSON→column mapping. Provenance N/A.

provenance.deterministicSeedRule: No seed for F-M1 — export_files and study_events rows are learner-authored at runtime, never seeded. Any future seeding of demo export rows would upsert on a deterministic id derived from provenance (never array index), additive/idempotent, no drop/reset (IDEMPOTENCY rule).
provenance.adminScopeNote: No admin/org objects touched. No net-new schema proposed. All F-M1 screen needs resolve against existing user-facing schema (export_files, study_events, generated-exports bucket, profiles).

notes: All 8 F-M1 screen requirements resolve against the LIVE schema with NO schema-gap-to-apply and NO unresolved rows. (b) 'PDF 다운로드 이벤트' — functional-spec.md L41 lists study_events.export_file_id, but the LIVE study_events table has NO export_file_id column; code (pdf-export.ts) records the linkage inside payload jsonb under event_type='export_downloaded' → jsonb-covered, no new column. export_files/storage_path currently use a Tier-1 browser-print MVP marker (browser-print://<uuid>, status='ready' immediately) with the real generated-exports stored-file path honestly 준비 중 — the column/bucket contracts are nonetheless fully present (satisfied). Two open 검수 items per screen-data-summary (options allowed-key catalog L61; retry-row-reuse L62) are undecided product questions, NOT schema gaps — existing columns support either resolution.
